subject: Acme Fintech — post-demo, stakeholder map & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver James <oliver.james@acme-fintech.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Fintech — post-demo & next steps

Hi Oliver / Sonia,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on our conversation: 

Summary:
- Use case: real-time risk scoring + chat-assisted reconciliation for merchant risk teams.
- Key decision criteria: latency under 250ms p50, on-prem/VPC option for PCI scope, clear audit logs and data retention controls.
- Expected initial throughput: ~50 concurrent sessions, ~1k tokens/sec peak.

Immediate next steps:
1) Can you confirm the procurement path: economic buyer, procurement/purchasing contact, and legal reviewer? (Names + emails)
2) We can prepare a short SOW + vendor packet for procurement — please share any vendor onboarding form or specific docs you require.
3) Technical POC: propose 2-week POC starting week of 11/18. Doable?
4) Pricing: I'll send a short commercial summary & options for Dedicated vs Private.

Attachments: Redwood_Proposal_Acme_20261110.pdf (proposal summary).

If you prefer a quick sync with procurement/legal on the call, happy to set that up — suggest a 30-min slot next week.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Oliver James <oliver.james@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Fintech — post-demo & next steps

Marissa, thanks — great demo. Long answer short: interested and we need to loop in procurement and legal. See preliminary stakeholder map below.

Stakeholders (prelim):
- Economic buyer: Sonia Patel, Chief Product Officer <sonia.patel@acme-fintech.com>
- Procurement/Purchasing: Aisha Khan, Senior Procurement Manager <aisha.khan@acme-fintech.com>
- Legal reviewer: Marcus Green, Senior Counsel <marcus.green@acme-fintech.com>
- Technical lead: Oliver James (me) for POC and integration

Procurement asks:
- Please provide W9, SOW template, data processing terms, and any security evidence (SOC2 report or equivalent).
- We have a vendor onboarding PDF — attaching it here: vendor_onboarding_form_acme.pdf.

Timeline: Procurement would like vendor packet this week; procurement review typically takes 2–3 weeks once packet is complete. POC start depends on paperwork but earliest practical start likely 11/18 if we get materials in the next 3 business days.

Quick Q on commercial: do you support net-30 PO and invoice to Acme Fintech (bill-to: Acme Fintech, Attn: A. Khan)?

Thanks,
Oliver

Thanks Oliver — that stakeholder map is perfect. Looping in Aisha to make sure we capture procurement requirements.

Per your asks, attaching the initial vendor packet: Redwood_W9_and_SOW.pdf (contains W9, draft SOW, and standard billing info).

Aisha — couple quick clarifications to help speed review:
- Billing: Redwood can invoice to Acme Fintech, Attn: Accounts Payable. Default payment terms we propose are Net-30 on the invoice; if PO required we can accept a PO referencing invoice number.
- Tax/Finance: W9 included in the attachment.
- Security: we can provide SOC 2 report under NDA; we also have a short security slide deck if helpful.
- Procurement packet: if you have a vendor onboarding form (Oliver attached one) please send it back with any required fields and I'll get legal to complete the vendor questionnaire.

Proposed cadence:
- Today: I’ll finalize the SOW draft and return it to Marcus/legal and Aisha for review.
- EOD 11/15: target to have the draft SOW + commercial (price breakouts) in your hands.
- Week of 11/18: begin POC pending completed vendor packet and PO (if required).

Attachments: Redwood_W9_and_SOW.pdf

Let me know if you want to jump on a brief IRL call with procurement/legal this week.

Best,

--
